equivalent_mutants.N2: With exact integer statistics |product - sum*mean| <= sqrt(variance)*norm (Cauchy-Schwarz); the binary64 error is far below 12.5%, so ratios in [1.125, 1.25) are unreachable. The CPU core has the same branch.
equivalent_mutants.F2: repairAll is set only when the Q28 range check fails (|anchor|+extent+1 > 2^31) or the error bound reaches 0.25, which needs 510*(1+extent)/2^29 >= 0.25, i.e. ROI width+height above about 263,000 pixels; the template limits keep it below about 131,600. Out-of-range ROIs sample border zeros in FP64; the mutant samples one pixel with the zeroed descriptor. Both are constant ROIs with NCC 0.

limits: one GPU (RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell, sm_120), one driver (596.71, WDDM), Windows only
bit identity assumes a host that does not contract warpPixel (x86-64 without FMA); an aarch64 host whose compiler contracts needs __fma_rn on the device
only the research coarse/frame API; no CUDA for fpm_match(), the GUI, Session, pose refinement or the full GPU pipeline
17 fixed fixtures only; no many-object or 8K scenes; no comparison with Metal
prepare (source copy, PCIe) not optimized; no Tensor cores or CUDA Graphs
